items.title: Unit 10 · Lesson 1 story
items.storyText:
Let's walk to the shops. What's the weather like? It's sunny.

Don't put on your coat, Billy. It's hot today. Children, put on your sun hats, please.

Oh no. It's windy. My hat! Catch it!

Oh no! Now it's raining. And we haven't got our umbrellas! Let's go home.

Quick, Grandpa. Open the door, please. Where's the key? Oh no, I haven't got the key!

Oh! Agh! Oh no, you're all wet!

Have a nice afternoon in the sun. It's seven o'clock and here is the weather. It's very windy outside now. It's a good time to fly a kite. But don't let your hats fly away!
